data.value: About RNE — Information for Ukrainians in Europe

data.name: About.MetaDescription
data.value: Learn how Refugee Navigator Europe researches and maintains practical information for Ukrainians navigating temporary protection and life across Europe.

data.name: About.Mission
data.value: Refugee Navigator Europe exists to make reliable public information easier to find and understand, so Ukrainian refugees and displaced people can navigate temporary protection and build their lives in Europe with greater clarity.

data.name: About.Coverage
data.value: Browse country information on temporary protection, residence and relocation, work authorization and employment, healthcare, housing, social assistance and benefits, and education. Compare selected topics to see how rules and arrangements vary between European countries.

data.name: About.Research
data.value: Information is researched using official sources, including government agencies and public institutions. Articles link to the sources used so readers can check details with the responsible authority. Country comparisons draw on published articles and their cited sources.

data.name: About.Maintenance
data.value: Content is checked against its cited sources before publication. Source links, relevant rules, and important dates or events are monitored and reviewed as part of ongoing maintenance; articles may be updated when this review identifies a change. Updates are not necessarily immediate. The date shown on an article means when its content was last updated; it is not a guarantee that every detail is current.

data.name: About.Independence
data.value: Refugee Navigator Europe is an independent information project. It is not a government service and does not represent the authorities or organizations whose sources it references.

data.name: About.Disclaimer
data.value: This website provides general information, not legal, medical or other professional advice. Rules and individual circumstances differ and may change. Check current requirements with the relevant official authority before making decisions. Information here does not establish eligibility for protection, work, services or benefits.

data.name: About.Support
data.value: If you find this resource useful, you can support its continued development, research and efforts to keep information up to date.

data.name: About.SupportVoluntary
data.value: Support is entirely voluntary. Access to information is free regardless of whether you choose to support the project.

data.name: Privacy.MetaDescription
data.value: Learn what information Refugee Navigator Europe uses for language and theme preferences, website requests and contact messages.

data.name: Privacy.Introduction
data.value: This notice explains what information is processed when you use the site or contact the project, why it is used, who receives it and how long it is retained.

data.name: Privacy.Operator
data.value: The project is operated by Alexandra Strona, an individual based in Portugal. For privacy enquiries or rights requests, use the Contact form and select “Privacy and personal data”. No personal email address or home address is published.

data.name: Privacy.Technical
data.value: The site is hosted in the Render Hobby workspace in Frankfurt, Germany (EU Central). The operator has confirmed that application logs are retained for 7 days. The current workspace does not include Pro-level HTTP request logs. This does not describe retention of every provider-side technical record. To deliver a page, your browser sends network and technical data that may include your IP address, requested path, time and browser user-agent. The application has no visitor accounts or user database and does not intentionally write contact form fields to its application logs.

data.name: Privacy.Preferences
data.value: When you choose a language, the site stores that preference in a cookie for one year. The cookie is HttpOnly, uses SameSite=Lax and is Secure on HTTPS requests. If no language preference cookie takes priority, the site can use your browser’s Accept-Language header. Your light or dark theme choice is stored in your browser’s localStorage under “theme” until changed or cleared; otherwise the site uses your device’s colour-scheme setting. The application contains no analytics or advertising trackers.

data.name: Privacy.ContactData
data.value: The form requires a topic and message; your name and reply email are optional. The application sends the submission to Formspree over HTTPS and does not save contact submissions in a project database. The information is used to handle and reply to enquiries, correct errors and maintain the project.

data.name: Privacy.Processors
data.value: Formspree receives and processes submissions and is configured to forward them to the project mailbox in Proton Mail (Free plan). The operator confirms that Formspree Submission Archive is disabled, Formshield filtering is enabled, CAPTCHA is disabled and the Formspree dashboard option labelled “HTTP API” is disabled. The application sends JSON to the configured Formspree HTTPS form endpoint; compatibility of that account setting with the endpoint has not yet been verified. Formspree says its service must not be used to collect sensitive personal data. Disabled archiving does not establish zero temporary processing, security logging or backups. Do not submit sensitive personal data, identity documents or medical information or records through this form. Include only the details needed to handle your website-related enquiry.

data.name: Privacy.Transfers
data.value: The Render service is configured in Frankfurt, Germany. Formspree states that it uses AWS infrastructure in the United States and relies on Standard Contractual Clauses for transfers. Proton Mail is linked to the project mailbox; Proton’s terms and DPA describe when a DPA may apply if a customer acts as a controller and the stated conditions are met. The project has not confirmed which provider data-processing agreements and safeguards apply to these accounts. The European Commission recognises Switzerland as providing adequate protection, but this does not mean all processing by these providers occurs in Europe. Provider policy links are references, not a claim that every applicable contract or safeguard has been verified.

data.name: Privacy.Retention
data.value: The operator retains correspondence in Proton Mail for 12 months after the enquiry is resolved, subject to justified legal exceptions. The application does not keep submissions in a project database. Formspree Submission Archive is disabled, but this does not establish zero temporary processing, security logs or backups. Render application logs in the configured Hobby workspace are retained for 7 days; this is not a retention period for every category of provider-side technical data.

data.name: Privacy.Rights
data.value: Depending on the law and circumstances, you may request access, correction, erasure or restriction, object to processing, or request portability where that right applies. Use the Contact form and select “Privacy and personal data”. The operator normally responds within one month. Where legally permitted, this period may be extended by up to two further months because of complexity or the number of requests; you will be told about an extension and its reasons within the first month.

data.name: Privacy.Complaints
data.value: You may lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority competent for you, including Portugal’s Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados (CNPD), where applicable, or another competent authority. The appropriate authority depends on your circumstances and applicable law.

data.name: Privacy.ThirdParties
data.value: Official-source links take you to external websites only if you choose to follow them. Ko-fi is an optional external support link; the site does not embed a Ko-fi widget. If you visit or use Ko-fi, it processes information under its own terms and privacy notice. The implications of the project’s existing Ko-fi functionality are included in the internal launch review. Provider policies and terms may change.

data.name: Privacy.LegalBasis
data.value: For contact messages, the operator intends to rely on legitimate interests under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR to handle enquiries, correct errors and maintain the project, subject to the required assessment of those interests. Article 6(1)(b) may apply where processing is necessary to take steps at your request before entering a contract, and Article 6(1)(c) where processing is necessary to meet a legal obligation. For site operation and security, the operator intends to rely on legitimate interests where applicable. The language cookie and browser storage remember preferences you choose; their applicable legal requirements will be assessed for the actual service. Consent is not used as a blanket basis. The legal basis for each activity must match the actual circumstances.

data.value: Understand the scope and limits of Refugee Navigator Europe’s general information, official sources and country comparisons.

data.name: Disclaimer.Purpose
data.value: Refugee Navigator Europe provides general information to help readers explore topics related to temporary protection and life in Europe. It is not individual legal, medical, financial or other professional advice.

data.name: Disclaimer.Changes
data.value: Legislation, official procedures, services and personal circumstances can change. Information may not reflect every recent change or local practice. An article’s update date indicates when its content was last updated; it does not guarantee that every detail remains current.

data.name: Disclaimer.Eligibility
data.value: General information on this site cannot determine whether a particular person qualifies for temporary protection, residence, work authorization, healthcare, housing, benefits or another service. Eligibility and decisions depend on current rules and individual circumstances.

data.name: Disclaimer.Sources
data.value: We link to official external sources where available. Before acting, check current requirements and procedures with the relevant authority or service provider for your situation. A linked source may change or become unavailable.

data.name: Disclaimer.Independence
data.value: Refugee Navigator Europe is an independent information project. It is not a government service and does not represent the authorities or other organizations whose sources it references.

data.name: Disclaimer.Comparisons
data.value: Country comparisons are informational tools that summarize selected topics. They may not cover every difference, exception or individual circumstance, and they do not establish which country or option is suitable for a particular person.
